    },
    {

      "section_type": "medications",
      "section_text": "She takes for which she uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.\n\nHome Medications:\n- Albuterol HFA inhaler 90 mcg (2 puffs) PRN for wheezing/shortness of breath\n- Prenatal multivitamin with folic acid 1 tablet daily",

  "patient_id": 2776,
  "date": "2021-07-15",
  "type": "ed",
  "chief_complaint": "Progressive dysphagia to solids and liquids with 10-pound unintentional weight loss over 3 months",

  "sections": [

      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "chief_complaint",
      "section_text": "Progressive dysphagia to solids and liquids with 10-pound unintentional weight loss over 3 months",
      "section_order": 0
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53794,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "hpi",
      "section_text": "Patient with Hodgkin lymphoma and ovarian carcinoma presents with dysphagia initially to solids and now to liquids. She also reports a 10-pound weight loss during this period.",
      "section_order": 1
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53795,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "pmh",
      "section_text": "Active Problem List:\n- Malignant neoplasm of ovary (diagnosed 2020-01-15)\n- History of Hodgkin lymphoma in remission\n- Post-radiation hypothyroidism\n- Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy\n- Chronic pain syndrome\n- Tobacco use disorder\n- Generalized anxiety disorder\n\nShe has a past medical history significant for Hodgkin lymphoma, for which she received chemotherapy and radiation therapy 15 years ago. She has been in remission since then.",
      "section_order": 2
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53796,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "psh",
      "section_text": "- Staging laparotomy with splenectomy (15 years prior)\n- Total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and optimal tumor debulking\n- Port-a-cath placement (right subclavian)",
      "section_order": 3
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53797,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "medications",
      "section_text": "Home Medications:\n- Levothyroxine 125 mcg PO daily\n- Gabapentin 300 mg PO TID\n- Oxycodone 5 mg PO q6h PRN pain\n- Ondansetron 8 mg PO q8h PRN nausea\n- Pantoprazole 40 mg PO daily\n- Lorazepam 0.5 mg PO BID PRN anxiety",
      "section_order": 4
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53798,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "allergies",
      "section_text": "NKDA",
      "section_order": 5
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53799,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "family_history",
      "section_text": "- Mother: Breast cancer at age 54\n- Maternal aunt: Ovarian cancer at age 61\n- Father: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease\n- Paternal grandfather: Pancreatic cancer",
      "section_order": 6
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53800,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "social_history",
      "section_text": "She has a 30-pack-year smoking history.",
      "section_order": 7
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53801,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "physical_exam",
      "section_text": "On physical examination, she appears cachectic. There is no palpable lymphadenopathy.",
      "section_order": 8
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53802,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "labs",
      "section_text": "Laboratory studies are unremarkable.",
      "section_order": 9
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53803,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "imaging",
      "section_text": "A barium swallow study shows an irregular narrowing of the distal esophagus.",
      "section_order": 10
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53804,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "pathology",
      "section_text": "Histopathology reveals a poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma.",
      "section_order": 11
    },
    {
      "section_id": 53805,
      "encounter_id": 11756,
      "section_type": "other_studies",
      "section_text": "An esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) with biopsy is performed,",
      "section_order": 12
    }
  ]
}

      "section_order": 1
    },
    {
      "section_id": 59923,
      "encounter_id": 12325,
      "section_type": "pmh",
      "section_text": "Active Problem List:\n- Cystic fibrosis (diagnosed 2020-01-15)\n- Cystic fibrosis (CFTR-related disorder, F508del homozygous)\n- Pancreatic insufficiency\n- Chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyposis\n- Bronchiectasis\n- Chronic pulmonary colonization with Pseudomonas aeruginosa",
      "section_order": 2
    },
    {
      "section_id": 59924,
      "encounter_id": 12325,
      "section_type": "psh",
      "section_text": "- Functional endoscopic sinus surgery (FESS) for nasal polyps - age 14\n- Port-a-cath placement (right subclavian) - age 15",
      "section_order": 3
    },
    {
      "section_id": 59925,
      "encounter_id": 12325,
      "section_type": "medications",
      "section_text": "Her current medications include inhaled tobramycin, oral azithromycin, and pancreatic enzyme replacement.\n\nHome Medications:\n- Tobramycin inhalation solution 300 mg inhaled via nebulizer BID on alternating months (28 days on/28 days off)\n- Pancrelipase (Creon) 36,000 units PO with meals and 18,000 units with snacks\n- Dornase alfa (Pulmozyme) 2.5 mg inhaled via nebulizer daily\n- Albuterol HFA 90 mcg (2 puffs) inhaled 15 minutes prior to tobramycin and dornase alfa\n- Hypertonic saline (7%) 4 mL inhaled via nebulizer BID after airway clearance\n- Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) 2000 units PO daily\n- CF-specific multivitamin (ADEK) 1 tablet PO daily",
      "section_order": 4
    },
    {
      "section_id": 59926,
      "encounter_id": 12325,
      "section_type": "allergies",
      "section_text": "NKDA",
      "section_order": 5
    },

      "section_type": "family_history",

      "section_order": 6
    },
    {
      "section_id": 59928,
      "encounter_id": 12325,
      "section_type": "social_history",
      "section_text": "She is accompanied by her parents, who are supportive and wish to be involved in the discussion.",
